subject.title: fix: normalize unsupported Anthropic inline images

question: Should unsupported Anthropic image transcoding become an optional public `AiTransportHost` capability, with direct `@openclaw/ai` consumers responsible for providing it?
rationale: The reusable package intentionally excludes OpenClaw's media backend, so real byte conversion requires either this additive public host seam, broader upstream sanitizer policy, or a larger package dependency redesign; repository policy requires owner judgment for that permanent API boundary.

options.title: Accept the host capability
options.body: Land the additive optional callback after documenting direct-consumer behavior and validating both configured and inert host paths on the refreshed head.

options.title: Move normalization upstream
options.body: Use the shared agent sanitizer instead, accepting broader cross-provider transcoding and proving every Anthropic image path reaches it.

options.title: Redesign package media support
options.body: Give the reusable package its own conversion abstraction or dependency, accepting a larger package and dependency-surface change.

recommendation.title: Accept the host capability
recommendation.body: Land the additive optional callback after documenting direct-consumer behavior and validating both configured and inert host paths on the refreshed head.

likelyOwner.reason: Introduced the reusable package and host-port design and has the strongest adjacent media-backend history.
